findings.text: pctx.Err() is non-nil when the parent context was canceled as well as when the probe budget ran out, so a Ctrl-C during the probe is reported as "timed out" and refused as agent-mismatch rather than as canceled. Check ctx.Err() first, or compare against context.DeadlineExceeded on pctx, so the two cases stay separate.

The match text "run" is a common word and is checked as a substring of the combined help output, so any clashing tool whose help mentions "run" passes the identity check. The same applies to fx at line 210 with "ask". Consider a more specific match such as the exact subcommand usage line, or document that the probe only rules out tools that fail the help command.

A personal row with probe_args set to [] passes validation because agentProbeFields only requires probe_match, but this guard returns early on an empty ProbeArgs, so the row launches with no probe at all. Either reject an empty probe_args in config or document that an empty list disables the probe.

The hint says to define the agent in settings.json with an absolute binary path. A shipped name cannot be redefined (bad-settings), so the operator has to choose a new name and then run --agent with that name. The manual says the same thing. Say that the new name must differ from the shipped one.
